comment: Occurrence records this project may redraw, split into 's' (preserved specimen) and 'o' (field observation). Deduplicated onto a 0.01 degree grid, which is under half a pixel on the map: two records closer than that were already one dot. Records outside Alberta and Saskatchewan, records coarser than 10 km, and records whose dataset licence does not permit redrawing the coordinate are all absent. The number of dots reflects how much collecting happened, not how much plant there is.
